C1729.title: Ghost Click: Hijacking Human Clicks for Ad Fraud via Script Injection
C1729.summary: This study exposes an ad fraud technique called Ghost Click. Attackers inject a server-side script (e.g., 123.php) into web pages visited by victims. Whenever a user performs a normal click, the script triggers a fraudulent ad click in the background, effectively hijacking genuine user interactions to steal ad attribution revenue.

references.title: Dissecting ghost clicks: Ad fraud via misdirected human clicks
